en: I really appreciate you taking the time to help me work through this little crisis of mine.
Thanks to you, I did pretty well! I don't know how to thank you. I feel like I'm ready to take on the actual test now!
That's good to hear.
Oh, about those questions you helped me with before... Not all of your answers were right.
For the first English question, the correct meaning of "locomotion" was "movement."
For math, the probability of rolling a total of 7 with 2 dice is 6 in 36, or 1 in 6, in other words.
For the history question, it was Commodore Perry who opened up Japan to the West.
For physics, the energy of an object based on its height above the Earth is called "gravitational potential energy."
And for that bullshit last English question, which was really a Latin question, "carpe diem" means "seize the day."
I see. So I got three out of five, huh?
I see. So I got four out of five, huh?
Yeah. Still, if I hadn't met you, it would have been completely hopeless for me.
Besides, you taught me something more important than what the right answer is. You taught me how to answer things in general.
But unfortunately, I ended up making a ton of mistakes based on what you told me.
What? You sure?
Uh-huh. Here's what the real answers were.
So... I didn't get anything right at all? That's a letdown.
I see. So I only got one out of five, huh? That's a letdown.
I see. So I only got two out of five, huh? That's a letdown.
That was way worse than a letdown. Based on the score I got, the practice exam was a complete failure. Maybe the worst I've ever done.
Oh... Sorry about that. I was sure I put you on the right track.
That said, the way you answered with such confidence really taught me a lesson.
It did?
Like you said, the right answer will always become clear eventually. Thinking about those words helped me stay calm and get through the test relatively unscathed!
At the very least, I feel like I'm a lot stronger mentally now. I might actually have a chance at passing the real exam!
That's good to hear. I'm glad I was able to help in some way.
I appreciate you taking the time to help me out. You taught me something more important than just rote memorization. Thanks a lot!
You got 1,800 experience points.

Hey, it's "the chicken who ran from Hide"! Wassup? You up
for that dance battle yet?
Or do you wanna keep the title?
Have it any which way you want. Later.

Tch, what a chickenshit, yo. And here I thought you were
a real hotshot.
I didn't say that, yo.
Oh, yeah? Then, that means you're takin' me on!

I don't like to lose. Plus, I've been watching Haruka dance
a lot lately, too.
Huh? What're you talkin' about?
Heh, nothing. All right, no backing down now. Let's dance.

Hahaha, I knew I was right about you! Let's get it on, yo!
Daaance battle, baby!

Shinada-san, you did it! Those photos were priceless!
Yamazaki's grimace of despair's gonna be on every tabloid
across Japan⑬courtesy of Nightlife Magazine!

I gotta tell you, that was no walk in the park. Going around
playing candid camera is totally not my specialty.

Nah, not at all! I'd say you're better off snapping
compromising photos than writing dirty articles!
This is seriously the work of a master!
Sure, if you say so. Now, let's talk money. You said you'd pay well for those photos, right?

Of course! The chief was strutting around like a peacock
over them!
You got <Color:8>10,000 yen<Color:Default>.
Aww yeah! And Tatsuo hits the jackpot!
You sure did, Shinada-san. Thanks for coming through for us... and for all who hold entertainment sacred!
You got 2,100 experience points.
Seriously!? Yamazaki caught you tailing him?
Uh... yeah...
No wonder Yamazaki suddenly went back to his hotel without any side trips. We thought something strange was going on.
Oh, is that what happened...
Man... What were you doing out there? We had the whole office mobilized to chase this lead. What a wasted effort.
Look, I'm sorry! I've never tailed anyone before. It's not like I'm a one-man detective agency.
All right, all right! I get it! I'm the idiot for asking your help in the first place. Sheesh...
But boy, are you a one-trick pony. Guess it's nightlife or nothing for you, huh?
All right, Shinada-san, get a move on. Your area is Kumano Boulevard. We need definitive evidence of Yamazaki meeting his girl on the side. That'll nail him good!
(Ooh! Are they heading into a love hotel? Oh yeah, baby⑬now it's about to get steamy!)
Yesss! Now, don't be shy! Let me see that money shot!
Hey, what the⑬ Stop it! Who the fuck are you? Get that camera out of here! Stop it, I said!
Eww, who is this creepazoid? Can you please go away?
Not until I smash that camera of his! Give me that shit!
Hehe, sucks to be you, scumbag! I got what I came for⑬and away I go!
Enjoy the rest of your date!
Get back here, you cockroach!

Hey, Michiruuu! It's meeee! Thanks for coming out here. ♪
Isn't this the <Italic>perfect</Italic> place for our secret rendezvous!?

Do you really have to talk so goddamn loud? Pipe down,
for fuck's sake!
Eep! He's angry! Teehee... That's hot. Almost as hot as when you're on stage! ♪

Holy crap, just shut up. Seriously. Not another word.
Listening to you wears me out.
Hey, that's mean! Why are you even seeing me, then?

Because I wanna rock that deviant little body of yours.
Now keep your blow hole shut until we get to the room.
(Welp. That must be the side chick. I'll slink along ever-so-silently until I can catch the moment of truth.)
Hey, you're a reporter, aren't you? I knew there was something fishy about you.
Oh, who, me? Nah⑬you must be mistaking me for somebody else.
...Uh-huh. Did you really think you could fool me?
Nope! Don't know what you're talking about!
Hello? Me again. Yeah, I have to cancel today. Some media prick's been following me around.

Wait, you've got it all wrong! I'm just a humble passerby!
And I'm definitely not trying to catch you in the middle of
your sexcapade so I can make money off the scandal!
Yeah, yeah, I'll make it up to you next time. I'll be throbbing for you, baby. Okay.
Hey, sleazeball.
Huh? I, uh, beg your pardon?
You're long past busted, dipshit.
...Crap.
Hey, what's your problem? I don't give autographs to dudes. Now quit following me⑬you're starting to creep me out.
(Dang, got a bit too close. I need to track him from a little farther away.)
(Huh? Where's Yamazaki? Don't tell me I lost him!)
(Oh, there's Yamazaki. Whew, can't lose sight of my meal ticket!)
(Hey, is that...?)
(Yup, that's him all right. Just look at this adulterous asshole! Well, whatever. Gotta get me those photos.)
Hello? Yeah, it's me. Are you off work? Huh? What's that?

Don't be stupid, babe. You know you're my one true love.
I told you, the others⑬they're just toys. Appetizers.
Bun warmers at best!

Haha, no, I don't plan on sleeping with any more fans...
Not for a while, anyway. Heheh... gotcha!

Uh-huh. Seriously. Wouldn't want another one cutting
herself... Yeah, she should've gotten rid of it sooner.
It's like, how do you not know you're incubating a fetus?

Uh-huh. Don't I know it. Okay. I'm on my way right now.
Hope you're ready to get naked.
(Man, that was some vile stuff you spewed out there... And you still have the gall to cheat? Better follow this douche from a distance.)
(Oh, it's Uda-san from the Sotenbori Merchants Association.)
Hello, Uda-san. What brings you here?
Oh, Sawamura-san. What a coincidence!

Do you think you could spare a minute or two? There's
something I'd like to show you.
Something to show me? What is it?
Take a look at this.
A photo of me?

I saw a junior high school student with it on the street.
But I know for a fact this didn't come from Dyna Chair.

Someone is stalking and secretly taking pictures of you, then
selling those photos without permission.
Someone's taking pictures of me? I honestly had no idea.

The work of a paparazzo, no doubt. I suppose that sort of
thing happens to many idols, but the Merchants Association
just can't allow it.

It would damage our reputation to have unauthorized photos
like this one being sold on the street!

I want to get this no good creep out of our town! And I'd
like to get your cooperation, Sawamura-san, if I may.
My cooperation? But what can I do?

Well, this paparazzo might be pointing his camera lens at
you from the shadows this very moment! That's how close he
might be at any given time.

So if you ever get the feeling someone is watching you, it
might very well be this paparazzo. Please be vigilant at all
times, especially on the street.

And if you happen to notice this paparazzo, could you
please give me a call? I'll drop everything and come
running.

Well, Dyna Chair really should be the one looking into this,
but yes, of course. I'll do what I can to help.

Wonderful! Just promise you won't try to apprehend him
yourself. We don't know what kind of man we're dealing with
here. He could be dangerous.
All you have to do is call me. I'll take care of the rest.
All right. Thank you.

Remember, stay vigilant! And take care. Thank you,
Sawamura-san.
(There he is again!)
Sawamura-san!
Uda-san!  There he is! That's the paparazzo!
Got it! Leave this to me!
*pant* *pant* We got him. Nice going, Sawamura-san!
I'm sorry! I'll never do it again! Just let me go!

I never noticed that someone was following me and taking
pictures...

No idea, right? You wouldn't believe the lengths to which we
go to stay unnoticed. It's practically an art!

"Art"!? I'll give you "art"! I'm kicking you out of this
town! If I see you here again, I'm calling the police!
Understood!?
Thank you very much for your help, Sawamura-san.

On behalf of the entire Merchants Association, I'd like to
give you this small token of our appreciation.

Heheh. Well, this isn't the last you'll see of paparazzi!
Wherever there's an idol, that's where we'll be!
Can it, buddy! Now, get lost! And never come back!
...Yes, sir.
You got 4,000 experience points.
(There he is! That's the paparazzo!)
(Uh-oh! He took off again! I'd better tell Uda-san!)
Uda here. Sawamura-san?

Yes. The paparazzo is running away! He's heading toward
West Sotenbori Street! Where are you now, Uda-san?

I'm almost to Shofukucho! Please keep him in your sights
just a little bit longer!
All right! I'll do my best!

(The paparazzo headed toward West Sotenbori Street. I can't
let him get away!)
(There! That must be him. I'd better call Uda-san.)
Hello. Uda here. Is that you, Sawamura-san?
Yes! I found the paparazzo! He's wearing a fishing vest!
Great work! And what is he doing now?

Oh, no! He just took off. It looks like he's heading toward
West Shofukucho!
All right! I'm on my way! Don't let him out of your sight!
All right! I won't!

(The paparazzo headed toward West Shofukucho. I'd better
get after him before he gets away!)
(Is it them...? No, they're just looking around.)
(But I'm sure I felt someone watching me!)
(No. Not them.)
(No, they're just smoking. That's not  him.)
(No, that's no paparazzo.)
(No. Not that's not him. Where is he?)
(No. Certainly not them.)
(No way. They're definitely not a paparazzo.)

(What're they taking a picture of? I don't think that's
him.)

(That person is taking a picture, but I don't think they're
with the paparazzi.)
What's going on, Michiru? Who is this guy?
Some dumbass reporter. He was tailing us.
No way! He's with the paparazzi?

Wait, you've got it all wrong! I'm just a humble passerby!
Whatever scandal you're involved in is of no interest to me!
...You lying little shit. You're long past busted. Now get lost!
(Great, there's no way I can follow them now... There goes that big scoop.)
...Crap!
...Hey. Am I trippin' or are we being followed right now?

Huh? There's no way... Not out here. Why, you see some kind
of paparazzi or something?
I dunno, babe... I just can't shake the feeling I'm being watched.
(Oops. Got a bit too close... I need to keep the right amount of distance.)
(Huh? Where's Yamazaki? Did I lose him?)
(Oh, there he is... Come on, man, don't lose him.)

Oh, Haruka-chan! Are you ready to show me how it's done
onstage? I'm ready if you are!

Well, I don't know how much of an "example" I can be. I'm
actually kind of nervous. But I'll certainly do my best!
Oh, thank you so much, Haruka-chan!

I'm sorry, Asuka-chan. I'm afraid I can't right now. Can you
give me a little more time?
